title: Lost Mary BM600 Cherry Peach Lemonade Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Cherry Peach Lemonade Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods combine sweet fruit with a sparkling citrus base. Juicy Cherry and smooth Peach deliver a soft, rounded sweetness, while Lemonade adds tang and fizz for a lively, refreshing vape. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, with up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, these pods deliver consistent flavour with no need for coil changes or refilling. Made for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, they’re quick to use and easy to install: simply click a pod into the device and enjoy a bright, fruity blend with a fizzy finish.
